findings.observation: Published API pages claim autogeneration from source, but no docs generator emits them and mkdocstrings is enabled without any `::: bioetl` identifiers.
findings.method: Repo search for `::: bioetl` / `:::` under docs/04-reference/api; inspect mkdocs.yml plugins; inspect scripts/docs for an API generator.
findings.expected: API reference either generated/checked against the public Python surface in CI, or explicitly curated without an autogen claim.
findings.actual: docs/04-reference/api/application.md:16, infrastructure.md:16, and composition.md:16 say 'Autogenerated from source code'. mkdocs.yml:121-130 enables mkdocstrings, but grep found zero `:::` identifiers in docs/. scripts/docs has no API-page generator. check_drift.check_classes only covers docs/02-architecture layer pages, not 04-reference/api.
findings.impact: Operators can treat curated API pages as current public API. Stale symbols can ship as 'current' because generator exit 0 / MkDocs strict build does not compare API docs to src/bioetl public surfaces.
findings.root_cause: mkdocstrings was added to the docs extra/plugin list without wiring identifiers or a generator; page banners still claim autogen.
findings.remediation: Either add mkdocstrings identifiers (or a generator + --check) for sanctioned public surfaces and gate them in docs.yml, or remove the autogen banner and add an architecture test that the published API tables match live __all__/facades.
findings.automation: CI: architecture test or mkdocstrings inventory vs public facades

evidence.observation: plugins include mkdocstrings with paths: [src] and allow_inspection: true.

findings.observation: Canonical `python -m scripts.docs verify` runs check-drift with a flag subset, so module/provider/glossary drift is skipped in the CI verify chain.
findings.method: Compare verify.py argv with check_drift._run_checks run_all behavior.
findings.expected: The advertised one-command verify chain includes all ERROR-level drift checkers, or documents the omitted slices as out of band.
findings.actual: verify.py passes only --ports --classes --runtime-mirrors --freshness. check_drift.py:1879-1841 sets run_all=False when any flag is set, so check_modules, check_providers, and check_glossary do not run. --modules is not referenced outside check_drift.py itself. check_ai_surfaces is covered separately by tests/architecture/test_ai_runtime_governance_links.py in docs.yml.
findings.impact: Renamed/removed bioetl.* module paths in architecture docs can pass docs.yml validate-mkdocs. Treating verify exit 0 as full semantic drift correctness is unsafe.
findings.root_cause: verify hard-codes a sliced flag set instead of the unflagged full check-drift run.
findings.remediation: Add --modules to verify (and either unflagged check-drift or explicit --providers/--glossary), plus a docs.yml/architecture test that check_modules passes on the current repo.

evidence.observation: check_modules/providers/glossary run only when run_all or their flags are set.

findings.observation: Internal Markdown image links (.png/.svg) are skipped by check-links, and MkDocs strict build downgrades missing files to info.
findings.method: Inspect check_broken_links skip and mkdocs.yml validation.links.
findings.expected: Published nav pages fail CI when referenced local files, including diagram images, are missing.
findings.actual: check_links.py:667-668 continues without existence checks for targets ending in .png/.svg. mkdocs.yml:93-96 sets validation.links.not_found: info while anchors stay warn. tests/architecture/test_docs_build_site_router.py only asserts anchors in {warn,error}, not not_found. Diagram render jobs run only when renderer inputs change.
findings.impact: Broken diagram/image embeds on published pages can pass both check-links and mkdocs build --strict.
findings.root_cause: Intentional workaround for locally/CI-generated PNG/SVG, without a compensating published-nav image existence gate.
findings.remediation: Check image targets that are referenced from mkdocs nav pages (or allowlist only gitignored **/png/**), and/or set not_found: warn for non-diagram missing files.
findings.automation: CI: extend check-links image existence for nav-published pages

findings.observation: mkdocs.yml advertises a GitHub Pages site_url that currently 404s, and no workflow deploys Pages.
findings.method: Read mkdocs.yml and publication policy; grep workflows for pages/gh-deploy; HTTP GET the advertised URL.
findings.expected: site_url matches a real publication surface, or metadata/policy make the non-published status obvious in the MkDocs config itself.
findings.actual: site_url is https://SatoryKono.github.io/BioactivityDataAcquisition/. web_fetch returned GitHub Pages 404. No pages/deploy-pages/peaceiris/mkdocs gh-deploy job exists. docs/00-project/governance/06-doc-publication-policy.md:263-268 correctly states docs.yml is validation-only, but site_url still looks like a live site. docs/03-guides/docs-verification.md:205 states there is no PR preview.
findings.impact: Users/operators following published metadata hit a 404. There is no PR preview; publication is local-only (docs/site or temp dir) with a public URL that is not live.
findings.root_cause: Publication was never enabled; site_url was left as a future GitHub Pages address.
findings.remediation: Either add an explicit Pages deploy workflow in the same changeset as policy/mkdocs.yml, or stop advertising site_url until publication exists.
findings.automation: CI: optional smoke GET of site_url or remove site_url

evidence.observation: HTTP body: Site not found · GitHub Pages 404.
docs.yml is a validation/build workflow, not a GitHub Pages deployment workflow.

findings.observation: ChEMBL field-matrix outputs are declared tracked_curated_generated_doc, but .gitignore does not allowlist them and the default output directory is absent.
findings.method: Compare generated_artifact_routing.yaml, .gitignore allowlist, DEFAULT_OUT_DIR, and directory listing.
findings.expected: Tracked generated docs declared in the routing registry exist in git and are freshness-checked in CI.
findings.actual: routing id chembl-field-matrix-generated-docs points to docs/reports/generated/chembl_activity_field_matrix/ with commit_policy tracked_curated_generated_doc. .gitignore:556-562 allowlists cleanup inventory, config-discrepancies, structural contract JSON, and pipeline_normalization md — not chembl_activity_field_matrix. list_dir of docs/reports/generated has no such directory. Unit tests write only to tmp_path.
findings.impact: Code-derived field-matrix SoT cannot drift-fail in CI because artifacts are neither tracked nor checked against DEFAULT_OUT_DIR.
findings.root_cause: gitignore retention allowlist and routing registry diverged; --check is not wired to docs.yml.
findings.remediation: Allowlist the field-matrix outputs in .gitignore (or change routing to working_output), commit the generator outputs, and add `python -m scripts.docs generate-field-matrix --check` to docs.yml.

findings.observation: The documented canonical ChEMBL workbook and dictionary outputs live under gitignored docs/reports/*, so the matrix maintenance pipeline depends on hidden local files.
findings.method: Read scripts/docs/README canonical workbook path, DEFAULT_WORKBOOK/DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR, and .gitignore /docs/reports/* allowlist.
findings.expected: Canonical inputs for docs generators that CI or contributors must use are tracked, or the README marks them as local-only and CI does not claim them.
findings.actual: .gitignore:549 `/docs/reports/*` with a narrow allowlist. scripts/docs/README.md:98-101 calls docs/reports/chembl_pipeline_silver_matrices_v12.xlsx the single canonical workbook. read_file reports that path as gitignored. build_matrix_dicts.py DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR is docs/reports/dictionaries, which is not allowlisted and does not exist in list_dir.
findings.impact: Workbook/dictionary commands cannot be reproduced from a clean clone. Anti-pattern: publishing/maintaining docs with hidden developer-local state.
findings.root_cause: docs/reports retention gitignore vs scripts/docs README still treating the xlsx as canonical tracked SoT.
findings.remediation: Move the canonical workbook to a tracked path (or Git LFS allowlist) and dictionaries to an allowlisted generated path, or rewrite README/CI to treat them as optional local-only and keep only the tracked JSON/MD matrices as SoT.

evidence.observation: /docs/reports/* ignore with allowlist that omits xlsx and dictionaries/

findings.observation: docs.yml path filters include .codex/skills and .devin/skills but not .codex/agents or .junie trees, so runtime-source-only PRs skip docs verify and runtime-mirror tests.
findings.method: Read docs.yml on.push.paths; compare with skills-consistency.yml and test_runtime_agent_docs_drift.py ownership.
findings.expected: Changes to canonical runtime docs that check-drift --runtime-mirrors compares must trigger the docs pipeline.
findings.actual: docs.yml lists '.codex/skills/**' and '.devin/skills/**' but not '.codex/agents/**' or '.junie/**'. test_runtime_agent_docs_drift.py is only in the docs.yml pytest list, not tests.yml. skills-consistency.yml does trigger on .codex/agents/** but runs doctor/runtime_skills, not check-drift --runtime-mirrors. Weekly docs-kpi-weekly.yml is the delayed catch.
findings.impact: A CODEX-RUNTIME.md change without a docs/skills touch can merge without runtime-mirror/freshness docs gates until Monday KPI.
findings.root_cause: Path filter inventory was expanded for skills/workflows, not agent runtime trees.
findings.remediation: Add '.codex/agents/**', '.junie/agents/**', '.junie/skills/**', and '.junie/guidelines.md' to both push and pull_request path filters in docs.yml.
validation: python -c "from pathlib import Path; t=Path('.github/workflows/docs.yml').read_text(); assert '.codex/agents/**' in t"

evidence.observation: paths include .codex/skills/** and .devin/skills/** only among runtime trees.
skills-consistency covers .codex/agents/** but not scripts.docs check-drift.

findings.observation: Architecture docs nightly regenerates the dependency map and uploads artifacts but does not fail when git diff is non-empty.
findings.method: Read architecture-docs-nightly.yml Collect drift summary step.
findings.expected: Scheduled regeneration either fails closed on drift or opens a tracked signal; silent green + artifact is not a gate.
findings.actual: The job runs --update, then `if git diff --quiet -- docs/02-architecture/generated; then ... else echo changed ... fi` and always uploads artifacts. No exit 1. PR path in docs.yml does --check plus 'Assert regenerated dependency docs are committed', so nightly is informational only.
findings.impact: Main can accumulate uncommitted generated architecture docs until a docs-path PR hits --check.
findings.root_cause: Nightly job is a collector, not a gate.
findings.remediation: Fail the nightly job (or a follow-up check job) when git diff is non-empty, or auto-open an issue/PR. Do not raise debt budgets.

evidence.observation: git diff --quiet writes a summary; no exit 1 on drift.

findings.observation: check-links never validates http(s)/mailto targets; MD_LINK_RE excludes them by design.
findings.method: Inspect MD_LINK_RE and grep check_links.py for http/external.
findings.expected: Published docs either have an automated external-link check or an explicit out-of-scope statement in the verify contract.
findings.actual: MD_LINK_RE = r'\[([^\]]*)\]\((?!https?://|mailto:)([^)#]+)'. check_links.py has no http/external runner. CI docs.yml therefore cannot catch a dead site_url or other published external URLs (see DOCS-PIPE-004).
findings.impact: Broken external references in published nav, including the GitHub Pages URL, do not fail the docs pipeline.
findings.root_cause: Link checker is file-existence only for relative targets.
findings.remediation: Add an optional --external check (allowlisted, rate-limited) for mkdocs-nav pages, or document external links as out of scope in scripts/docs/README and REQ-DOC-001.

evidence.observation: MD_LINK_RE negative lookahead skips https?:// and mailto:

findings.observation: Matrix generators expose --check, and some outputs are tracked, but docs.yml never runs those --check commands.
findings.expected: Tracked generated docs with a --check mode are freshness-gated in the docs workflow.
findings.actual: export_structural_contract.py, generate_field_matrix.py, generate_pipeline_normalization_matrix.py, and sync_structural_policy.py all implement --check. docs/reports/generated/chembl_matrix_structural_contract_v1.json and pipeline_normalization_field_matrix.md are git allowlisted. Workflow grep found no invocations. docs.yml validate-mkdocs runs check-links, entity-config-parity, verify, and architecture dependency --check only.
findings.impact: Tracked matrix JSON/MD can go stale relative to code while docs.yml stays green.
findings.root_cause: Matrix tooling has check modes and unit tests on tmp_path, but no workflow wiring for DEFAULT_OUT_DIR.
findings.remediation: Add --check steps to docs.yml (or verify.py) for export-matrix-structural-contract and generate-pipeline-normalization-matrix; include generate-field-matrix after DOCS-PIPE-005.

evidence.observation: No workflow references to matrix --check commands.

findings.observation: docs extra pins mkdocs-mermaid2-plugin, but mkdocs.yml does not load that plugin.
findings.method: Grep mkdocs-mermaid2 / mermaid2 across repo; read mkdocs.yml plugins.
findings.expected: Docs extra contains only packages the MkDocs config actually uses.
findings.actual: pyproject.toml docs extra includes mkdocs-mermaid2-plugin>=1.1 (uv.lock 1.2.3). mkdocs.yml plugins are only search and mkdocstrings. Mermaid is extra_javascript mermaid-init.js + pymdownx.superfences custom fence. Grep found no other mermaid2 references.
findings.impact: Unused dependency in the docs toolchain; extra install surface and supply-chain noise. Not a build break.
findings.root_cause: Plugin leftover after switching to client-side mermaid-init.js.
findings.remediation: Remove mkdocs-mermaid2-plugin from the docs extra and refresh uv.lock, or actually enable the plugin if that is the intended renderer.

findings.observation: Raw MkDocs writes to repo-root site/, while scripts.docs build-site normalizes to docs/site/.
findings.method: Compare mkdocs.yml site_dir with scripts/docs/build/mkdocs_build.py defaults; .gitignore entries.
findings.expected: One documented output directory for local site builds.
findings.actual: mkdocs.yml:7 site_dir: site. mkdocs_build.py _DEFAULT_SITE_DIR is docs/site and _LEGACY_SITE_DIR is repo-root site, cleaned after a successful packaged build. verify.py uses a TemporaryDirectory and never writes either. .gitignore lists both site/ and docs/site/.
findings.impact: Operators running `mkdocs build` vs `python -m scripts.docs build-site` get different output locations. Both are gitignored, so this is operator confusion rather than VCS pollution.
findings.root_cause: Packaged build-site added docs/site normalization without updating mkdocs.yml site_dir.
findings.remediation: Set mkdocs.yml site_dir to docs/site (or keep site/ and change build-site default) and document one command.
findings.automation: architecture test already targets the router; extend to assert mkdocs.yml site_dir == docs/site

findings.observation: docs-governance pins Python 3.13 while validate-mkdocs uses the setup-python-uv default 3.12.
findings.method: Read docs.yml job setup steps and action.yml default python-version.
findings.expected: The same docs workflow uses one pinned Python for governance tests and MkDocs.
findings.actual: docs-governance: python-version: "3.13". validate-mkdocs Setup Python + uv only sets uv-extras: docs, so action default python-version 3.12 applies. uv is pinned to 0.11.26 in the action (good).
findings.impact: Docs checks can disagree across jobs on 3.12 vs 3.13 interpreter behavior. Unlikely to break MkDocs today, but the toolchain is not one pin.
findings.root_cause: docs-governance was bumped to 3.13 without updating validate-mkdocs.
findings.remediation: Pass the same python-version to both jobs (prefer the repo's documented default).

findings.observation: docs-kpi-weekly.yml and architecture-docs-nightly.yml checkout without persist-credentials: false, unlike docs.yml jobs.
findings.method: Read checkout steps in the three docs-related workflows.
findings.expected: Read-only docs workflows disable credential persistence on checkout.
findings.actual: docs.yml jobs set persist-credentials: false. docs-kpi-weekly.yml:20-21 is a bare actions/checkout pin. architecture-docs-nightly.yml:21 is the same. permissions.contents: read reduces risk.
findings.impact: Low: GITHUB_TOKEN may remain in local git config on the runner. Not a secret leak in generated docs.
findings.root_cause: Inconsistent checkout boilerplate across docs workflows.
findings.remediation: Add persist-credentials: false to both scheduled docs workflows.

evidence.observation: checkout step has no persist-credentials: false

findings.observation: validate-mkdocs runs full check-links and then `python -m scripts.docs verify`, which runs check-links again.
findings.method: Read validate-mkdocs steps and verify.py default steps.
findings.expected: CI runs each expensive docs check once, or the second invocation is a documented narrower slice.
findings.actual: Step 'Run documentation integrity guardrails' is unflagged check-links (run_all). Step 'Run canonical docs verification chain' is verify, whose first step is again unflagged check-links. The JSON report is only produced by the first invocation.
findings.impact: Longer docs job; no extra semantic coverage. Not a correctness bug.
findings.root_cause: verify was added as the canonical chain without dropping the earlier explicit check-links step (kept for --report-json).

evidence.observation: check-links then verify in the same job

findings.observation: pre-commit check-yaml excludes mkdocs.yml, so YAML syntax/structure errors are only caught later by MkDocs build.
findings.expected: The MkDocs config is linted locally or by a dedicated parser test before CI build.
findings.actual: check-yaml exclude includes mkdocs.yml (and docs/** yaml). CI still fails on invalid YAML via verify's mkdocs build. Local pre-commit will not.
findings.impact: Broken mkdocs.yml can be committed and only fail in the docs extra CI job.
findings.root_cause: mkdocs.yml uses YAML features/size that made check-yaml noisy, so it was excluded.
findings.remediation: Add a cheap architecture test that yaml.safe_load(mkdocs.yml) succeeds (test_docs_build_site_router.py already safe_loads a subset) as a required unit/architecture check without docs extra.

findings.observation: Shell transport prefers the first PATH python that can import mkdocs over .venv/.venv-win, which can hide the project-pinned docs extra.
findings.expected: Docs builds use the project venv / uv-run interpreter with the locked docs extra.
findings.actual: build_docs_site.sh:30-35 tries `python` then `python3` if `import mkdocs` succeeds, then .venv/bin/python, then Windows .venv/Scripts. scripts/docs/README still documents the shell as compatibility transport; preferred route is python -m scripts.docs build-site.
findings.impact: On mixed PATH machines a global mkdocs can build with a different plugin set than uv.lock. CI uses uv run --frozen, so CI is safe.
findings.root_cause: Compatibility shim optimizes for 'any mkdocs' rather than the locked extra.
findings.remediation: Prefer .venv / .venv-win / uv run before PATH python, matching Windows .venv-win policy.

evidence.observation: PATH python with import mkdocs is selected before ./.venv

findings.observation: Field-matrix --check is unit-tested only against tmp_path, never against the declared DEFAULT_OUT_DIR, so missing tracked artifacts do not fail tests.
findings.method: Read unit tests and DEFAULT_OUT_DIR; confirm directory absence.
findings.expected: If routing says tracked_curated_generated_doc, a repo-backed --check (or architecture test) must fail when DEFAULT_OUT_DIR is missing or stale.
findings.actual: Tests call write_artifacts/check_artifacts with tmp_path. DEFAULT_OUT_DIR is docs/reports/generated/chembl_activity_field_matrix. Directory is absent from docs/reports/generated listing. Combined with DOCS-PIPE-005 this is a closed loop: tests green, artifacts missing, CI ungated.
findings.impact: False confidence that the field-matrix pipeline is CI-protected.
findings.root_cause: Determinism tests were written as pure unit tests without a repo-backed freshness gate.
findings.remediation: Add a repo-backed test or docs.yml step that runs generate-field-matrix --check against DEFAULT_OUT_DIR once gitignore allowlists the outputs.
